I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I told her I can't confirm the 23 May deadline because nothing she has access to mentions Thornbury Cloth Co.: no account folder, contract, CRM note or earlier channel message.

I also pointed out that 23 May has already passed (today is 14 Oct). So the date was either misheard, means next May, or refers to an older order form. I said I'm treating it as unverified and suggested she confirm it in writing with her Thornbury contact or the account owner before anyone plans around it.

I didn't record the date anywhere, and nothing here needed approval.
